description: Mirrors the client's existing package master workbook field for field, so migrating it is an import rather than a re-derivation.

fields.description: The client's own code, e.g. 3Kw 1PH, 5KW 3PH Micro.
fields.label: Specification Code

fields.description: The default pricing option's cost: what the package costs as it is offered.
fields.label: Package Cost

fields.description: The default panel, inverter, battery and Balance of System, with the KSEB, Mounting and Installation amounts. Worked out on save; prices do not use it.
fields.label: Total Package Cost

fields.description: The default inverter option's topology, set on save. Each inverter option has its own on the Inverter tab.
fields.label: Inverter Topology
fields.options:
String
String with Optimiser
Microinverter
Hybrid

fields.description: Untick to retire the package: design estimates no longer offer it.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Draft until checked. Design estimates offer Draft and Active packages alike.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The user's default company, set on save when blank.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The module options this package may be built with. Tick one as the default - the proposal, the cost estimate and the handoff read that row.
fields.label: Solar Panels

fields.description: The inverter options this package is quoted with, each with its own price. Tick one as the default - the net rate, the proposal and the handoff read that row.
fields.label: Inverter Options

fields.description: Only for Off-Grid and Hybrid packages. Energy is volts x Ah x nos.
The boards, cables, structure, meters, earthing and protection this package includes, each with its own price. Tick one row per type as the one quoted.
fields.label: Balance of System Components

fields.description: Application, registration and net meter fees fill in from the Statutory Fee Schedule, by the package's single or three phase connection, and follow it on every save. Registration is charged on the default inverter's capacity. Add rows for any other KSEB expense.
The first row fills in from the Roof Type: panel capacity x its mounting structure rate, refreshed on every save. Add rows for any other structure work.
Mounting and installation are priced on it.
fields.label: Roof Type

fields.description: From the Roof Type on the Mounting tab: panel capacity x its installation rate. The specification is yours to edit.
Extras a customer can take on top of this package - an extra panel later, an extended inverter warranty. Printed in the proposal as 3.3.3 Optional Add-ons; not part of the package price.

The materials the system is built from besides its panel, inverter, batteries and balance of system. A row naming inverters is needed only with those; a blank one with every inverter. Create BOM / Update BOM adds the rows of the default inverter. Upload Excel fills the table from a sheet: Item Name, Category, UOM, Quantity, Rate, Amount, Depends on Inverter.
fields.label: Material BOM

fields.description: The materials the mounting structure is built from. A row naming roof types or capacities (kW) is needed only with those; a blank one with every one. Create BOM / Update BOM adds the rows of the package's own roof type and capacity. Upload Excel fills the table from a sheet: Item Name, Category, UOM, Quantity, Rate, Amount, Depends on Roof Type, Panel Capacity (kW).
fields.label: Structure BOMs

fields.description: What the package costs to build, line by line: each an Item with its category, unit, quantity and rate. A costing record - the package's price comes from its inverter options' Cost. Upload Excel fills the table from a sheet: Item Name, Category, UOM, Quantity, Rate, Amount.
fields.label: Expenses
Dealer Commission Rule
fields.description: Prices the Dealer Commission row of the Expenses. Formula: base + amount per kW x capacity. Percentage: of the cost before the commission and the margin. Lump Sum: a fixed amount.

fields.label: Base Amount
fields.description: Paid on the package whatever its size.

fields.label: Amount per kW
fields.description: Times the package's capacity.

fields.label: Commission Percentage
fields.description: Of the panel, inverter, battery, installation, materials, structure and other expenses - not the margin.

Each way the package is priced: a panel, an inverter and a battery of its own at a package cost. More rows, more options. An estimate is priced at the row for the panel and inverter it is built with; tick one row as the default - its cost is the Package Cost.
fields.label: Pricing Options

fields.description: How the customer pays for a job on this package - e.g. 70% advance, 20% after installation, 10% after commissioning. The job's billing plan is built from these, and the Advance Payment checks the advance received against them.
fields.label: Payment Terms

fields.description: For a job the customer pays for.
fields.label: Payment Terms

fields.description: For a job financed by a bank loan. Blank: the terms above.
fields.label: Payment Terms (Financed)
